pragma solcore;

import {Echo} from math;
enum Amount { Amount(word) }
enum Flag { Flag(bool) }
impl Echo<Amount> { function echo(x: Amount) returns (word) { return 1; } }
impl Echo<Flag> { function echo(x: Flag) returns (word) { return 0; } }
trait Other<t> { function echo(x: t) returns (word); }
impl Other<word> { function echo(x: word) returns (word) { return x; } }
function main() returns (word) { let x: Amount = Amount(7); return Echo.echo(x); }
